_about: Path-B (generic buyable-part) eval fixtures for the eBay resolver's two-tier, seller-distinct gate. Run each `query` against GET /api/vision/ebay-health?q=... The KEY assertion is category-dependent: OEM-specific parts should resolve one canonical PN; multi-brand wear parts (rotors/pads/wipers/filters) legitimately have MANY valid SKUs, so a null verifiedPartNumber is CORRECT there — confidence comes from spec + live listings, not PN agreement.
